title: Independent first-party review of the unresolved CS2 picks
policy: Every value below was read from the linked first-party source inside the research window, or is explicitly attributed to the production pipeline observation at 2026-10-16T04:21Z (live data/origination.json with its saved per-provider evidence). Values that could not be confirmed are left blank. Hotspawn community percentages are never read. This dossier documents why each unresolved fixture has or has not a pick; it never overwrites the automated pipeline output, which recomputes everything on its own schedule.

method_change_verified_this_session.summary: Both model-fallback paths (scripts/originate.py model_estimate and scripts/domain.py valve_analysis) now exclude name-matching Valve rows whose roster is not a complete five-player record BEFORE the uniqueness test, exactly matching the documented 'unique exact-name, five-player record' rule. A name with several complete five-player rows stays rejected as ambiguous.

limitations: This dossier is dated research for the 2026-10-16T04:17Z-04:45Z window. The production pipeline recomputes every pick from fresh evidence every four hours and is authoritative.

Money-source 'no-line' observations are the production pipeline's saved first-party evidence at 2026-10-16T04:21Z; wide-book rejections were re-read first-party by this session with the numbers shown.
Valve estimates are uncalibrated research model outputs with fixed RD 75; they never override a money line and do not confirm today's rosters, stand-ins or vetoes.
Start times left blank were not re-verified by this session and are never inferred.
Blocked fixtures stay blank and flagged on the Flagged for Review page and the unresolved section; no default 50/50 is ever emitted.
